findings.rationale: The IAM policy grants Action * on Resource *, which allows any permitted principal to perform any supported operation rather than only the narrowly intended action.
The IAM policy scopes its statement to Resource *, so the grant is not constrained to the specific S3 bucket or other intended resource.
The IAM policy grants Action * on Resource *, and the S3 bucket separately applies acl = public-read, allowing the wildcard identity policy to reach anonymously readable storage.
